content: For English punctuation, the evaluation is measured on each type of punctuation and overall F1 score. For the punctuation restoration task, we care only about the performance of the samples belonging to the classes that are tagged to words followed by punctuation; therefore class INLINEFORM0 , which represents words not immediately followed by punctuation, is ignored in the evaluation. Consequently, the overall F1 score does not include INLINEFORM1 as the positive class in f1overall. INLINEFORM2 INLINEFORM3
